blocks.text: Before marketing a product or service, it is essential to understand the market. This involves identifying potential customers, their needs, and how your product can address those needs.
Example: If you are selling traditional Pakistani clothing, your target market includes individuals preparing for Eid or weddings, as these events typically require traditional attire.
